panelIntro: Pick where translations go and which engine writes them.
hintEngine: Google needs no key; AI uses any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
hintTarget: The language translations are written in.
hintProvider: One list: built-in endpoints and the models.dev catalogue, alphabetically.
hintModel: Models this provider lists. Pick Custom model to type your own.
hintEndpoint: Filled from the provider. Type your own to override it; it is kept when you switch provider.
hintApiKey: Stored in this Joplin profile only.
hintReasoning: Lowest means the cheapest effort this model offers ({RESOLVED}).
providerRequiredError: Choose an AI provider in settings before translating.
statusRefreshFailed: Could not refresh the catalogue; using the cached list.
commandTranslateNote: DualTran: translate note into a new note
msgTranslatedInto: Translated into a new note in "{FOLDER}".
settingsEngineDescription: Google needs no key; AI uses an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
settingsTargetDescription: Advanced override for the settings panel. Language code, e.g. zh-CN, en, ja.
settingsProviderDescription: Advanced override for the settings panel: provider id from the catalogue.
settingsEndpointDescription: Base URL; /chat/completions is appended when missing. A local Ollama works here (http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1).
settingsModelDescription: Advanced override for the settings panel: model id.
settingsReasoningDescription: Advanced override for the settings panel: lowest, none, minimal, low, medium, high.
